description: QUALITY OF EXAMPLE CORPUS, NOT MARKET SIZING OR AN ESTIMATE OF UNIQUE EQUIPMENT SALES
metrics_caveat: Only numeric equipment_voltage_kv fields are counted as explicit normalized voltage; many older verified descriptions contain 6-35kV text but lack numeric normalization, so this is a completeness KPI not real PQ market share. Mixed/adjacent tenders and survey requests remain in denominator of research examples; do not use NMC total as market value.
